pages.title: Quadrupole Focusing Magnet
pages.text: A quadrupole magnet with four pole tips that squeeze a particle beam in one direction while stretching it in the other. Pairs of them focus a beam the way lenses focus light. Its four poles alternate north and south around the bore, and the field between them is zero at the very centre.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A beam spreads as it travels. Quadrupoles focus it like lenses. I fitted quadrupole pole tips to a superconducting coil on spacetime casing and the beam stayed tight.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Hyperion Synchrotron.
